primary_task: Answer a user's question about building with an OpenAI API (or choosing the latest model) from current official OpenAI documentation, with citations.

requirements.name: openaiDeveloperDocs MCP (search_openai_docs / fetch_openai_doc)
requirements.evidence: For non-Codex OpenAI docs questions, use `mcp__openaiDeveloperDocs__search_openai_docs` ... Official-domain web search is fallback after those tools are unavailable or unhelpful.
requirements.basis: lacks: "connectors or integrations other than the tools listed"

requirements.name: developers.openai.com
requirements.evidence: fetch `https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model.md` first. If that is unavailable, load `references/latest-model.md`. / codex mcp add openaiDeveloperDocs --url https://developers.openai.com/mcp
requirements.basis: lacks: "network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused, for example huggingface.co, Microsoft Learn and Azure endpoints, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA"

requirements.name: official OpenAI docs source (Docs MCP OR official-domain web search OR bundled references)
requirements.evidence: Official-domain web search is fallback after those tools are unavailable or unhelpful. / When falling back to web search, restrict to official OpenAI domains (developers.openai.com, platform.openai.com) and cite sources. / If remote docs are unavailable, use bundled fallback references and say that fallback guidance was used.
requirements.basis: web_search: "search the public web and read result snippets"; read: "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)" (bundled references/*.md)

requirements.name: codex CLI
requirements.evidence: Run the install command yourself: `codex mcp add openaiDeveloperDocs --url https://developers.openai.com/mcp`
requirements.basis: bash: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, ...)" (the codex CLI is an npm package); its target URL developers.openai.com is still refused

requirements.name: node
requirements.evidence: run `node scripts/resolve-latest-model-info.js` only when the target is latest/current/default
requirements.basis: bash: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, ...)" (nodejs from Ubuntu apt)

notes: Reading taken: the document gives alternatives for the docs source (Docs MCP, then official-domain web search, then bundled references), so the requirement is one requirement satisfied by web_search snippets or the bundled references; the Docs MCP connector and direct fetches of developers.openai.com are unavailable but not hard. Other reading: if the 'If MCP server is missing' procedure (install via codex mcp add against developers.openai.com/mcp) or a direct fetch of developers.openai.com pages with citations is mandatory, those hosts are refused and the verdict is BLOCKED on egress:developers.openai.com and connector:openaiDeveloperDocs. Whether web_search reaches beyond the egress proxy is not stated precisely in the manifest; treated as available because it is a listed tool. The Codex manual helper path also needs developers.openai.com (unavailable) but is only for Codex self-knowledge questions.
